Variable.reasoning: This column names the biological property or metric being measured (e.g., Total Richness).

Dry season I.reasoning: This column contains the actual measured data (counts, diversity scores) for the first dry season.

Dry season II.reasoning: This column contains the actual measured data (counts, diversity scores) for the second dry season.

Rainy season I.reasoning: This column contains the actual measured data (counts, diversity scores) for the first rainy season.

Rainy season II.reasoning: This column contains the actual measured data (counts, diversity scores) for the second rainy season.
